name: eric-secret-garden-r2
description: Eric's garden game with a pinned vgpu WebGPU scene and playable Canvas fallback.

scripts.shader:check: vgpu check src/render/vgpu/shaders/soil.wgsl --require-validation && vgpu check src/render/vgpu/shaders/garden.wgsl --require-validation && vgpu check src/render/vgpu/shaders/hardscape.wgsl --require-validation && vgpu check src/render/vgpu/shaders/vegetation.wgsl --require-validation && vgpu check src/render/vgpu/shaders/sky.wgsl --require-validation && vgpu check src/render/vgpu/shaders/blit.wgsl --require-validation
scripts.check: npm run shader:check && npm run test && npm run build
